theorems.signature_bound: K Boolean extension bits induce at most 2^K signatures on at most 2^n root assignments; hence signature-separation arguments give K >= log2(M) <= n <= N.
theorems.parity_compression: PARITY_n is computed by frozen B2 grammar using 3(n-1) extension gates via iterative XOR; root-only CNF/DNF requires 2^(n-1) full cases.
